extension.valueMarkdown:
The parent who holds the child's paper DVCs and the family phone, and presents them; IHE ITI VHL VHL Holder and smart-trust Holder.

**Persona**: A parent carrying a newborn's records across borders on paper and one shared phone; no health training, little time, limited connectivity.

**Also known as**: VHL Holder (IHE ITI VHL); Holder (SMART Trust)

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

- ![Bounmy](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) [Bounmy](personas.html#bounmy-father--holds-the-family-phone-onesa), Bounmy SENGMANY (father, holds the family phone)
- ![Khamla](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) [Khamla](personas.html#khamla-mother-onesa), Khamla SENGMANY (mother)

**In the user scenarios**:

- [J1 — Born abroad](scenarios.html#j1--born-abroad-taifafeki-birth-day): J1 An Onesan baby is born in Taifafeki
- [J2 — Found at home](scenarios.html#j2--found-at-home-onesa-3-weeks-later): J2a A health worker finds the baby — and reads his cards; J2b Registered at home, and referred
- [J3 — Made official](scenarios.html#j3--made-official-lomaru-district-health-center-4-weeks-later): J3a The clinic confirms the cards are genuine; J3b Taifafeki vaccines are fitted to the Onesan schedule
- [J4.0 — Crossing back: one family, one phone](scenarios.html#j40--crossing-back-one-family-one-phone-onesa-12-months-later): J4.0a One phone holds the whole family’s records (told through Bounmy); J4.0b Dad creates a link to share at the clinic (told through Bounmy)
- [J4.1 — Crossing back: a Taifafeki doctor sees the full history](scenarios.html#j41--crossing-back-a-taifafeki-doctor-sees-the-full-history-kesaro-12-months-later): J4.1 A Taifafeki doctor sees the full history

**On the device screens**: [S1 Birth Abroad & Printed DVC QR Cards (Dr. Anan's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S1/); [S2 Offline QR Scan of the Foreign Cards (Vilay's phone)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S2/); [S3 Newborn Registration & Clinic Referral (Vilay's phone)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S3/); [S4 Clinic Referral & GDHCN Verification (Chanthason's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S4/); [S5 Terminology Adjudication & National Schedule (Chanthason's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S5/); [S6 One Family, One Phone Household Wallet (Bounmy's phone)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S6/); [S7 VHL QR Display & Passcode Protection (Bounmy's phone)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S7/); [S8 Foreign Clinic VHL Viewer & Audit Trace (Dr. Anan's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S8/)

**Discussed in the workshop modules**: [M1 From journey to capabilities](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m1/); [M2 The reference architecture and where you stand](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m2/); [M3 Standards, specifications and the core data set](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m3/); [M4 Trust, credentials and wallets](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m4/); [M5 Governance, decision rights and the legal basis](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m5/); [M6 Doing it once, together](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m6/); [M7 Our first move, what it costs, and what we ask for](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m7/)

**User stories** ([all stories](scenarios.html#user-stories)):

- I want to have my son's birth doses from abroad recognised at home, so that his care does not start over and nothing is repeated
- I want to show each family member's records abroad from our one shared phone, with a passcode I can say aloud, so that a doctor abroad can treat us without paper or an app
- I want to decide who sees my child's record, and for how long, so that the record stays at home and I know who has looked

**Lanes and tasks in the business processes**:

- [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): its lane holds no task
- [J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B](business-processes.html#j2-discover-and-refer-an-unregistered-infant-in-country-b): Show the paper DVCs from Country A
- [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): its lane holds no task
- [J4.0 Issue the family's records to one phone as VHLs](business-processes.html#j40-issue-the-familys-records-to-one-phone-as-vhls): Choose who to share, with a passcode and an expiry
- [J4.1 Read a family member's records at the point of care abroad](business-processes.html#j41-read-a-family-members-records-at-the-point-of-care-abroad): its lane holds no task
